phases.name: Glanceable trend on the entry screen (US-007, single slice)

steps.name: Pure glance core greens its property suite
steps.description: Implement the RED-scaffolded pure Domain Core module (core/glance.py): glance(entries) -> GlanceSummary | None, quantize_rate, rate_glyph, per ADR-006, until all 9 DISTILL glance properties pass. No I/O, no clock, no shell imports.
criteria: All 9 glance properties green: determinism, entry-order invariance, value == trend-line END, rate == trailing-week net change, sparse-rate honesty at the 7-day entry span, empty -> None, first entry -> value without rate, pinned quantization grid, glyph from rounded sign
Glance value equals the last point of the shipped trend_series for the same entry set (single smoothed series, oracle = OUT-5)
Rate is None below a 7-day ENTRY span (latest - earliest entry date) and present at exactly 7 and beyond; empty record yields no glance
Quantization is the ADR-006 expression verbatim (round-half-even float ties pinned, including 0.025 -> 0.0); glyph reads → for anything rounding to 0.00, including negative zero
Domain core imports nothing from shell/adapters (import-linter contract holds)
steps.implementation_notes: DESIGN pins honored verbatim: D-12 rate = smoothed[-1] - smoothed[-8] on the daily grid ending at the LAST ENTRY day (span >= 7 days <=> grid >= 8 points, so the lookback is always defined, even across gaps); glance value = series END (where the graph's line ends, not today); quantize = round(rate / 0.05) * 0.05 with built-in round (banker's ties pinned as-is). Pure-function contract shape (return-only); no mutation universe. Module placement is the crafter's call (fold into core/trend.py allowed) but the property suite and acceptance steps import from core.glance -- re-export from there if folded, in the same step. Remove __SCAFFOLD__ when GREEN. EXEMPT FROM PARADIGM: DISTILL-authored PBT properties (Mandate 9, PBT-full layer 1) are the unit-level coverage for this step.

steps.name: Walking skeleton: glance rendered with the log and refreshed by the save
steps.description: First e2e RED-to-GREEN through the production composition root: GET / renders the glance line in the initial HTML (reusing the already-fetched entries), POST /entries saved responses carry the glance display text for the in-place refresh, the save handler updates the line without a reload, trend.glance.shown appended per delivery, /stats gains trend_glance_shown_count. Covers the enabled walking-skeleton scenario plus the sushi-morning save-refresh (same production surface); unskip the sushi scenario only.
criteria:
Entry screen shows the neutral glance element

Trend: {value} kg · {glyph}{rate} kg/week

in the first server-rendered HTML whenever a glance exists; identical markup for every direction

Saved POST /entries responses carry "glance": "<display text>"; the save handler refreshes the line in place (no reload) to the trend recomputed with today's entry, rate co-revising with the line (RTS co-revision: current pair coherent, prior renders never asserted)
Each delivery of glance data (GET / render with data, saved response carrying glance) appends exactly one trend.glance.shown event; GET /trend is untouched and still emits trend.view.opened per open
GET /stats reports trend_glance_shown_count (present even at zero)
Zero added I/O or HTTP on GET /: glance derived from the entry list already fetched for the yesterday anchor
steps.implementation_notes:
D-13 delivery pinned: server-render on GET / + glance field in the POST /entries JSON response; KPI-3 separation is STRUCTURAL -- the glance path never touches GET /trend. D-14 pinned: event name trend.glance.shown, fired per delivery, no per-day dedup (KPI-5 pairing is computed at read time on /stats). Executable HTTP contract = GlanceService docstring in tests/weight-trend-tracker/acceptance/steps/composition.py: value at 0.1 kg, rate as {glyph}{abs:.2f} kg/week (glyph directly prefixes the magnitude, pinned to the AC literal), rate segment absent below the 7-day entry span, element absent with no data. Formatting lives in shell/template, never in core; glance summary injected as a pure callable at the composition root (established functional-DI pattern, routes.py TrendProjection alias precedent) -- no new adapters, no new probes (pure over the already-probed EntryStore). Read-only surface: no write methods on read ports. WeightLogging port untouched -- glance field and event are route-level concerns (bounded-change universe stays one {date} row + entry.saved event + the glance delivery event per the glance-aware capture). Presence-first assertions: steps anchor on the element's presence/absence, so RED here is assertion-RED, not KeyError-BROKEN.

steps.name: Render semantics: directions, sparse honesty, empty record's first glance
steps.description: Complete the glance display semantics on the render and first-save surfaces: single-glance coherence with the graph, the three direction glyphs with identical quiet styling, the steady 0.00 case, rate held back below the 7-day entry span (entry-based, boundary rows log ON the boundary day), a resting record reporting its line's end, and the empty record gaining its first glance from the save response. 6 scenario blocks (10 instances). Unskip one at a time.
criteria: The glanced trend value is where the graph's trend line ends and the displayed rate is that line's own trailing-week change, for the same entry set
Direction glyphs ↓ / ↑ / → render from the rounded rate's sign with identical neutral markup in every direction; a steady record reads a trend with → 0.00 kg/week plainly
Below a 7-day ENTRY span the trend value shows with no rate segment; at exactly 7 days (entry logged on the boundary day) the rate appears
A resting record (last entry a week old, 15-day span) still shows both value and rate, the value being the line's END -- same as the graph
An empty record shows no trend line; after the very first save the glance appears via the save response with that value and no rate, and the delivery lands on the record
steps.implementation_notes:
DESIGN pins: entry-based span semantics (D-12: latest - earliest ENTRY date, NOT today-based -- the resting-record scenario is the pin's discriminator: 15-day span, week-old last entry, rate stays, value = series end); glance value = series END at the last entry day; first appearance rides the save response (page had no element at 0 entries -- the save handler must create/show the line, not only update it; also the KPI-5 day-1 pairing case). Rate-absent rendering: no rate segment at all (value-only text), per the young-record outline and GlanceService expected_text oracle. The core already answers all of this from 01-01 -- this step is shell rendering/formatting fidelity plus the first-appearance handler path; most scenarios may green quickly, unskip one at a time and fix the surface each demands.

steps.name: Entry primacy, degrade-to-null, and KPI separation on /stats
steps.description: The glance never taxes the morning: entry screen interactive within budget with focus and keypad intact, a failing trend computation hides the line (render) and yields glance null (save) without ever blocking entry or save, a rejected save carries no glance and records no delivery, and /stats keeps deliberate trend views apart from ambient glances (7 home mornings + 2 graph studies -> trend views 2, glance deliveries 7). 5 scenario blocks.
criteria: Entry screen ready within two seconds with the weight field focused and decimal keypad shown, glance present -- the line never receives focus and never delays input readiness
When the trend computation fails, GET / renders with no glance element and the screen stays ready for immediate typing; no 500s (raise_server_exceptions holds)
When the trend computation fails, a valid save still confirms and stores exactly one entry; the saved response carries "glance": null and no glance delivery is recorded
A rejected save (e.g. 824) stores nothing, carries NO glance field, and appends no trend.glance.shown event

After 7 ambient entry-screen mornings and 2 deliberate graph trend views, /stats reads trend views this week 2 and glance deliveries 7 -- KPI-3 unpolluted by construction, glance rows readable back from the real store
steps.implementation_notes:
D-13 degrade pin: failure degrades to glance = null -> absent line; saving is NEVER blocked or delayed by the glance (KPI-1 entry-primacy guardrail). Shell-level containment around the injected glance callable on both delivery surfaces; the core stays pure and exception-free by contract. Save-response null semantics are three-valued and pinned: saved-with-data = display text (+event), saved-degraded = null (no event), rejected = key ABSENT (no event, nothing stored -- unbounded-preservation shape: the record and trail are untouched). D-14: no per-day dedup -- 7 renders = 7 trend.glance.shown rows, read back via the real SQLite trail (@real-io @adapter-integration); GET /trend must remain byte-for-byte untouched (asserted via trend views this week = 2). Deliberate-absence scenarios carry chained Given RED anchors -- do not remove them (red-classification note 2). After GREEN: refactor pass, then per-feature mutation testing (>= 80% kill rate) scoped to core/glance.py + touched routes/template; register OUT-7 (deferred from DISTILL, candidate row in feature-delta) and re-run nwave-ai outcomes check-delta if the CLI is fixed.
